verdict.rationale: Signifyd's docs show device fingerprinting via a checkout-page script (device-profiling) and APIs (Checkout/Sale) that submit structured order/payment data for scoring, which supports feeding some business-specific signals. However, there is no evidence of a documented mechanism for arbitrary custom metadata or behavioral-signal fields beyond the fixed order/payment schema, so full model-customization is unclear. missing for 10: explicit custom metadata/field support in Sale/Checkout payloads, documentation of behavioral-data ingestion, and independent confirmation that custom signals actually influence scoring.
